outlook.title: Well Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure is forecast to form this weekend well to the south of southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions appear favorable for gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to form early next week while it moves westward to west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.

outlook.title: Central Pacific
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure could form well south of the Hawaiian Islands over the weekend or early next week. Some gradual development is possible thereafter while the system moves slowly west-northwestward, well south-southwest of the Hawaiian Islands.
